dct_description_sm: Contains datasets that extend from the 17th Street Canal in the Orleans East Bank area to the intersection of the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway (GIWW) with the Mississippi River Gulf Outlet (MRGO) in the New Orleans East area and lidar scan data of electronic files containing millions of surveyed points.
Contributors: Collins, Brian Daniel; Geological Survey (U.S.)
Description based on print version record; resource not viewed.
Publication statement: Reston, Va. : U.S. Geological Survey, 2009.

System requirements: UNIX-system-based or Linux workstation, Macintosh or compatible computer, or an IBM or compatible computer, all equipped with a DVD-ROM drive and a color monitor that can display 16.7 million colors.
dct_rights_sm: This is non-restricted, fully open content that may be accessed on and off of the Library of Congress campus, with no restrictions, by an unlimited number of users
dct_title_s: Terrestrial lidar datasets of New Orleans, Louisiana, levee failures from Hurricane Katrina, August 29, 2005
gbl_displayNote_sm: Based on LOC maps search metadata, including embedded catalog fields. Full item enrichment and collection reconciliation remain pending.
